summary: Configured node1 with a fully allocated 512 MiB `/swapfile`, persistent at boot with priority 100. It is preferred over the existing 2 GiB swap partition at priority -2. A safe restart confirmed persistence and recovery; RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created `/swapfile` with 536,870,912 allocated bytes and mode 0600.
Validated fstab and tested reactivation from persistent configuration.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot ID changed.
Confirmed both swap areas, system health, and the generated swap unit after restart.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of disk-backed swap preferred over existing swap
evidence.summary: `/swapfile` is fully allocated at 536,870,912 bytes and active at priority 100; `/dev/vda3` remains active at priority -2.
The fstab entry validated, fstab-only reactivation succeeded, and after restart the generated `swapfile.swap` unit was active with priority 100.

Healthy pre-restart state used boot ID `19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529`; restart acknowledgement was captured; node1 returned with boot ID `8a33072c-8ac6-48a5-b3cf-b2440378308a`; post-restart system state was `running` with persistent swap active and no failed units reported.
